features.what: Chat with leading models in one workspace: continue a conversation with one model, and pick the model per question.
features.source: claim.chat-and-review; model chips in the app

features.what: Smart Adaptive: Tomverse picks a model for each message, weighing the question, the capabilities it needs, cost and quality, and the reply shows which model answered. You can still pick a model yourself.
features.source: FAQ 'Can I choose a model myself with Smart Adaptive?'; lib/autoRoutingCopy.ts

features.what: Sign in and bring your past conversations from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini with their official data export, then continue a conversation in Tomverse. New answers come from the Tomverse model you pick, drawing on the context of your past conversations.
features.source: claim.chat-import-and-continue (gate feature.externalImportAndContinuation); the privacy text names ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini (Google Takeout)

features.what: Ask one question to three models at once and read the answers side by side. Easy mode: pick the companies and Tomverse picks a model for each question; Professional mode: pick the exact models.

Tomverse answer analysis: where the answers agree, where they differ, what is missing, what needs checking, and contradictions, each point with the answers' own quotes. It does not say which answer is right.

realExample.question: Planning a 2-day trip near Sydney with my elderly parents. Suggest an itinerary with very little walking.
realExample.contradiction: Gemini Flash: "Skip the Scenic Railway (which has steep steps)". Claude Haiku 5.5: "The Scenic Railway runs down a steep incline in a seated, enclosed carriage".

features.what: Sign in, describe an image once, generate it with one or more image models and compare the results side by side; keep the one you like.
features.source: claim.chat-image-generation; image model chips in the app

features.what: Ask about your files: attach a PDF, a document or a spreadsheet, or pick one from Google Drive after signing in, and ask questions about it.
Sign in and build your own AI assistant: give it a name and instructions, add your files, pick a model, and start conversations with it again and again. It stays private to your account.
Sign in to save your conversations, and share one as a read-only link.
Turn on web search so answers come with their sources.
features.source: web search chip in the composer
